summary.text: Julie Olthoff is a Republican state representative who represents Indiana House District 19, has served since 2020 after an earlier term from 2014 to 2018, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. She is a business owner who founded VIA Marketing.

paragraphs.text: Julie Olthoff graduated from Lew Wallace High School and earned a B.A. from Indiana University Northwest.
Her career experience includes working as the art director of Ad-com Advertising and founding VIA Marketing.
Olthoff first held the District 19 seat from 2014 to 2018, and Ballotpedia's campaign finance records show she lost the 2018 general election.
She won the seat again in 2020, assuming office on November 4, 2020, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the November 3, 2026 general election she faces Democrat Nick Neal.
For 2025-2026, she was assigned to the Commerce, Small Business and Economic Development (as vice chair), Family, Children and Human Affairs, and Rules and Legislative Procedures committees.
